title: ErrorResponse
description: Body of every 4xx and 5xx JSON response of the HTTP API. error.code is a stable machine-readable string (forbidden, bad-json, invalid-request, unsupported-media-type, body-too-large, not-found, method-not-allowed, queue-full, not-ready, internal); error.message is for people and may change. A 400 invalid-request response also lists every shape problem found in errors.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the request, e.g. /design/matrix/0/1.
